```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:


```{r test_ui}

ui = fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Graphic overview of data "),

  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(

      selectInput(inputId = "y",
                  label = "Y-axis:",
                  choices = c("bwave", "awave", "bwave_imp_time", "awave_imp_time"),
                  selected = "bwave"),
      
      selectInput(inputId = "x",
                  label = "X-axis:",
                  choices = c("stimulus", "timespan", "genotype","gender", "treatment"),
                  selected = "timespan"),
      
      
      radioButtons(inputId= "split",
                   label="Split by (vertical axis)",
                   choices=c("stimulus", "timespan", "genotype", "gender", "treatment", "none"),
                   selected = "none"),
      
      radioButtons(inputId= "split2",
                   label="Split by (horizontal axis)",
                   choices=c("stimulus", "timespan", "genotype","gender", "treatment", "none"),
                   selected = "none"),
      
      radioButtons(inputId = "col",
                  label = "Color by:",
                  choices = c("stimulus", "timespan", "genotype","gender", "treatment"),
                  selected = "genotype")
      
    
    ),

    mainPanel(
      plotOutput(outputId = "boxplot")
      
    )
  )
)

server = function(input, output, session) {
  
  facet_formula <- reactive({
  row <- if (input$split == "none") "." else input$split
  col <- if (input$split2 == "none") "." else input$split2
  
  as.formula(paste(row, "~", col))
})

  output$boxplot = renderPlot({
    ggplot(data = ERG_data, aes_string(y = input$y, x = input$x)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.colour="red", outlier.shape = 8, outlier.size = 3)+
      geom_dotplot(binaxis='y', stackdir='center', dotsize=0.5, aes(color=get(input$col)))+
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))+
      facet_grid(facet_formula())
      
  },  width=1000,
    height=600)

}


shinyApp(ui, server)
```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
plot(pressure)
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
